newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Simeon Wines declares 12 cent dividend.
newsitem.headline: Simeon Wines declares 12 cent dividend.

text.p: Simeon Wines Ltd said on Wednesday it had declared an interim dividend of 12 cents per share for the year to June 30, 1997.
The company said the record date to determine entitlements would be June 27 and the dividend would be paid on July 25.
The company is currently making a cash and scrip offer for fellow wine maker, Australian Vintage Ltd (Austvin), which values that company at about A$111 million.
Simeon said the new shares issued under the bid would not rank for the interim dividend.

"The interim dividend has been declared in lieu of a final dividend for the year ending June 30, 1997 in order that the new Simeon shares issued pursuant to the proposed takeover can be listed on the Australian Stock Exchange as one class with existing Simeon shares," the company said.
The company also advised that its dividend re-investment plan had been suspended until further notice.
